speedup_definition: FLA median ms / PTO median ms; >1 means PTO faster

fla_metadata.benchmark_name: Gated DeltaNet chunk operator forward and backward on Ascend NPU

input_configuration.q_and_k_normalization: L2 normalized before operator call; normalization excluded from timing
input_configuration.gate_definition: g = logsigmoid(standard normal samples); beta = uniform samples in [0, 1)

measurement_method.synchronization: torch.npu.synchronize before sample loop and after each timed call

statistics.p10_ms: Sorted sample at zero-based index 3; no interpolation
statistics.p90_ms: Sorted sample at zero-based index 26; no interpolation

mode_definitions.backward: torch.autograd.grad for q, k, v, g, beta using a forward graph constructed outside timing, retain_graph=True; includes internal recomputation of transformed keys/values and recurrent states, reuses saved forward tensors including cumulative gates and triangular-solve result
mode_definitions.forward_backward: Fresh autograd-enabled forward followed by torch.autograd.grad for all five inputs; directly measured, not the sum of separate timings

pto_measurement.forward: Cache-saving forward; preallocated buffers; two warmup calls per mode; synchronized wall time including dispatch.
pto_measurement.backward: Both forward caches; one warmup; synchronized wall including six output allocations, workspace allocation and native dispatch; no autograd wrapper.
pto_measurement.inputs: q=0.1*randn, k=L2-normalized randn, v=randn, g=-0.1*uniform, beta=uniform; absent h0/dht.
pto_measurement.state_outputs: Forward also returns final state; backward also returns dh0. FLA requests neither.
pto_measurement.caveat: Shape-matched reported timings, not a controlled same-dtype, same-input or same-allocation benchmark.
